notablePrerequisites: You have a spell in hand with mana value equal to the number of charge counters on Chalice of the Void.
description:
Cast any spell that has a mana value equal to the number of charge counters on Chalice of the Void.
Chalice of the Void triggers, exiling the spell and casting it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.
